title: Relationships
subtitle: A calm, private place for the people and groups you choose.
entryBody: A future Home may replace the visible door without moving relationship, group, invitation, conversation, or history identities.
entryPreview: Preview only: Home → Relationships; the stable resource is unchanged.
emptyBody: Nothing is manufactured. Connect someone only when you choose.
virtual: Large set: the canonical implementation requires virtualization.
connectBody: Code, file, and QR are projections over one invitation identity. Nothing is sent or persisted here.
ready: Ready to preview a local directional relationship.
formed: Local directional relationship reference previewed. Nothing was sent or persisted.
deliveryHeld: Delivery stays held until invitation, identity, decision, and local reference are valid.
vexBody: Vex may explain or open the same registered door. Vex cannot decide, persist, or revoke a relationship for you.
vexShow: Ask Vex to explain this step
vexExplanation: Verify the counterpart, choose your own scope, and remember that delivery never proves understanding or friendship.
recoveryBody: Block, revoke, withdraw, disconnect, and reset affect future reference actions; they do not rewrite history.
blocked: Blocked. New actions are held; prior reference history remains.
revoked: Revoked. Later invitation/session use is rejected; prior history remains.
withdrawn: Withdrawn. New participation is held; prior history remains.
disconnected: Disconnected. Delivery is NOT_CONNECTED; the local relationship reference is not deleted.
bookletBody: The list and visible nodes reuse the same canonical relationship identities.
